items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Phil Napoleon had a band there at that time too and I--- at Nicks I think he was at that time---

ctx.x: My big ambition was that I had the money; I could go around and listen to all the bands and the town was loaded with bands; there was 52nd Street and Tommy Dorsey up at the Astor Roof, and all these things were happening -- and, uh, Phil Napoleon had a band there at
that time too and I--- at Nicks I think he was at that time---
